chapter: Philadelphia, New York and Sam Wooding in Europe
title: No marriage, only music and study
summary: Asked about his personal life, he says he never married and spent his time studying the trumpet in Europe.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: What did you do after you came back to New York --
Let me ask you first -- we haven't really gotten into your personal life. Did you -- had you married at this point?

Oh, no, no, I never married, I was only interested in music. I wasn't thinking about women, I had no girlfriends, I believe I had one girlfriend over there, but I didn't have time for that. You know I was writing and studying -- I did a lot of studying while I was there.
I studied all the time. I wanted to learn more about the trumpet.
